### Can plant data be exported, and who has to sign off?

1. Plant data must stay inside the European Union, and Brightline Cloud keeps the aggregated telemetry in its Frankfurt region with replication to other regions switched off. [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 4]
2. Kestrel Analytics only ever gets aggregated, pseudonymized telemetry; raw telemetry is never passed to it. [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 4]
3. Any export above 5 GB needs Elena Voss to approve it, and smaller exports without personal data are not allowed for engineers unless someone approves them. [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 4]
4. USB storage devices are banned at Ridgeway and Harbor Point; at Northfield a USB export is possible only on the encrypted laptop NB-04 after Tomás Ferreira has unlocked the port. [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 4]

| Trigger | Consequence | Source |
|---|---|---|

### When is expired plant data deleted, and what about legal holds?

- A nightly job removes data with an expired retention period, starting at 01:30. [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5]
- ArchiveVault backups are retained for 35 days, which means a deleted record may survive in a backup for up to 35 additional days. [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5]
- It is not true that data under a legal hold cannot be deleted after its retention period has run out. [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5]
- Only Hannah Brooks of the legal department sets or lifts a legal hold, and pausing the deletion job requires either an active legal hold or a written order from Elena Voss. [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5]

1. Für die Außerbetriebnahme braucht es ein Ticket von Florian Brandt, und ein Ersatzgerät darf erst ins Werksnetz, nachdem Lukas Hoffmann die Firmware 3.9.4 darauf aufgespielt hat. [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 7]

- Every gateway pushes its telemetry to the FleetView console at 10-second intervals, and the Kestrel Insight dashboard presents the aggregated figures. [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 6]

items.answer:
### Team und Termine bei Projekt Nebula

- Das Kernteam zählt 9 Personen, darunter 2 Entwicklerinnen und Entwickler sowie 5 Data Engineers, dazu je 1 Designerin und 1 Product Owner. [Doc: nebula-projektplan.md, Chunk: 2]
- Die Entwicklung leitet Lena Park, Product Owner ist Tom Becker. [Doc: nebula-projektplan.md, Chunk: 1]
- Der Lenkungskreis kommt jeden Dienstag um 10:00 Uhr zusammen. [Doc: nebula-projektplan.md, Chunk: 3]
- Beim Kickoff am 14.09.2026 waren Lena Park, Tom Becker und Marta Silva dabei. [Doc: nebula-kickoff.pdf, Chunk: 1]

**Is remote access to the admin interface possible from outside the plant network?**

No — the specification rules out any remote access to the admin interface from outside the plant network; remote maintenance can only go through the SecureRelay appliance that Altamesh Networks supplies [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 4].

- Approval given by phone is not accepted, so a session needs written approval before it starts [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 4].
- Sofia Lindqvist of Corvane Systems support can join sessions for GW-17 and GW-22, but she is not allowed to change firewall rules [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 4].
- Vendors get no access to GW-31 at Northfield until its firmware has been updated [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 4].

Restating the question: what are the hard environmental limits of the gateway, and does it accept Power over Ethernet?

| Topic | What the specification says |
|---|---|
| Power over Ethernet | Not supported; the gateway runs on 24 V DC within an input range of 18 V to 30 V DC [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 2] |
| Temperature | Operation is permitted from -20 °C to +60 °C, and the gateway must not be operated above 60 °C, not even briefly [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 2] |
| Outdoor use | The IP54 housing is not approved for outdoor installation unless the EK-2 enclosure from Corvane Systems is used [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 2] |

The housing has no fan, and relative humidity has to stay between 10 % and 90 % without condensation [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 2].

**Which firmware rules matter before anyone touches a gateway?**

1. Firmware 4.2.0 must never be installed: Corvane Systems withdrew it, which Sofia Lindqvist confirmed on 2 May 2027 [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 5].
2. Automatic updates are switched off on every gateway, and Marcus Hale installs updates by hand in the Sunday maintenance window from 02:00 to 05:00 [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 5].
3. Unsigned firmware images are rejected [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 5].
4. Rolling back to the previous version is permitted only when the new version has failed its acceptance test [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 5].

**Who may touch audit logs and camera footage under the plant data policy?**

- **Operators** only have read access to the Kestrel Insight dashboard and cannot export any data [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 3].
- **Engineers** can read and change gateway configurations, although deleting audit logs is not allowed for them [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 3].
- **Contractors** get access to neither audit logs nor camera footage [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 3].

Gate camera footage is only made accessible once Elena Voss has approved it, and shared accounts are not permitted at any site [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 3].

**Can a gateway simply be shipped back to Corvane Systems?**

It is not permitted to take a gateway out of service without a decommissioning ticket signed by Tomás Ferreira of IT security [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 7]. Before shipment, the WipeTool from Corvane Systems erases the configuration and all certificates, and a wipe certificate is filed in ArchiveVault [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 7]. No gateway goes back to Corvane Systems unless that wipe certificate exists [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 7].

Storage modules from GW-31 are never shipped; they are physically destroyed at Northfield [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 7].

**Under what conditions is expired plant data kept instead of deleted?**

| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Nightly deletion | Data past its retention period is removed by a job that starts every night at 01:30 [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5] |
| Legal hold | It is not allowed to delete data under a legal hold, not even once its retention period is over [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5] |
| Pausing the job | The job is not halted unless a legal hold is active or Elena Voss has ordered a pause in writing [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5] |

A legal hold can be set and released only by Hannah Brooks of the legal department [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5].

**Which outside vendors and tools does the plant rely on, and for what?**

- Corvane Systems makes the EG-400, while the SecureRelay appliance used for remote maintenance comes from Altamesh Networks [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 1] [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 4].
- Telemetry goes every 10 seconds to the FleetView console, and the Kestrel Insight dashboard displays the aggregated values [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 6].
- After 7 days on the gateway, logs are forwarded to ArchiveVault [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 6].
- Brightline Cloud holds the aggregated telemetry in its Frankfurt region, and Kestrel Analytics only ever receives aggregated, pseudonymized telemetry [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 4].

Sources: [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 1], [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 4], [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 6], [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 4]

**Who has which part in the plant data retention and access policy?**

Elena Voss, the data protection officer, owns the policy, and Grace Whitfield, plant manager at Ridgeway, approved it on 18 March 2027 [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 1]. Accounts in ArchiveVault are administered by Marcus Hale, whereas Daniel Okafor may only view, not export, the session recordings of his shift [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 3].

At Northfield, USB export works only on the encrypted laptop NB-04 and only after Tomás Ferreira has unlocked the port [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 4]. Legal holds are set and released solely by Hannah Brooks of the legal department, and she placed the Northfield gate camera footage under a legal hold two days after the failed audit there [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5] [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 6].

**How do the three gateways differ in firmware and behaviour?**

| Gateway | Site | Firmware | Notable event |
|---|---|---|---|
| GW-17 | Ridgeway | 4.2.1 | The acceptance test of 4.2.1 passed at Ridgeway on 14 May 2027 [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 1] [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 5] |
| GW-22 | Harbor Point | 4.2.1 | Memory usage fell from 71 % to 58 % after the update [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 1] [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 5] [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 6] |
| GW-31 | Northfield | 4.1.8 | The update to 4.2.1 failed on 9 June 2027 because the flash partition was full [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 1] [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 5] |

Separately, message latency at Harbor Point rose from 120 ms to 180 ms after the update to 4.2.1, and GW-31 was offline for 3 hours on 22 July 2027 following a power failure at Northfield [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 6].

**Which ports does the gateway use, and which are switched on out of the box?**

- Port 8443 (HTTPS) serves the local admin interface and is enabled by default [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 3].
- Port 8883 carries MQTT over TLS telemetry to FleetView and is also enabled by default, whereas the unencrypted MQTT port 1883 for legacy telemetry is disabled [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 3].
- Port 502 handles Modbus TCP machine polling on LAN1 and is enabled, while SSH on port 22 for vendor diagnostics is disabled [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 3].
- Port 1883 must not be enabled on production gateways, and Telnet is not supported [Doc: Edge Gateway EG-400 operating specification (sample), Chunk: 3].

**How long is each kind of plant data kept, and where?**

| Data | Kept for | Where |
|---|---|---|
| Raw telemetry | 30 days | On the EG-400 gateway [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 2] |
| Aggregated telemetry | 400 days | Brightline Cloud [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 2] |
| Audit logs | 730 days | ArchiveVault [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 2] |
| Remote session recordings | 180 days | ArchiveVault [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 2] |

Gate camera footage stays on the on-site camera recorder for no longer than 14 days unless a legal hold applies, and deleted records can linger in an ArchiveVault backup for up to 35 more days [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 2] [Doc: Plant data retention and access policy (sample), Chunk: 5].

**Will leftover money be available next year, and who signs off on larger spending?**

No — unused funds do not carry over to 2027 [Doc: Budget 2026 for marketing and Project Alpha (sample), Chunk: 4]. Any spending above 5,000 EUR has to be approved by the budget owner, which for the marketing budget is Lena [Doc: Budget 2026 for marketing and Project Alpha (sample), Chunk: 4] [Doc: Budget 2026 for marketing and Project Alpha (sample), Chunk: 3].

Of the 50,000 EUR for online campaigns, 15,000 EUR are reserved for the Project Alpha launch campaign [Doc: Budget 2026 for marketing and Project Alpha (sample), Chunk: 3].

**Is it acceptable for Project Alpha to send user data to a cloud provider outside the EU?**

Not in unencrypted form: it is not permitted for any user data to reach cloud providers outside the EU without encryption, and GDPR compliance has to be ensured before the launch [Doc: Project Alpha launch plan (sample), Chunk: 4].

In practice, the GPU server is in Germany and runs vLLM in a data centre in Frankfurt [Doc: Project Alpha launch plan (sample), Chunk: 3] [Doc: Weekly sync, 9 September 2026 (sample), Chunk: 2]. It handles about 40 concurrent users, and a second server can be added within two days [Doc: Project Alpha launch plan (sample), Chunk: 4].

**Who owns which part of the Project Alpha launch?**

- Michael leads development, builds the Supabase connection for the vector database and reports the spending every month [Doc: Project Alpha launch plan (sample), Chunk: 3] [Doc: Budget 2026 for marketing and Project Alpha (sample), Chunk: 2].
- Sarah owns the frontend design in Figma and prepares the release notes [Doc: Project Alpha launch plan (sample), Chunk: 3] [Doc: Weekly sync, 9 September 2026 (sample), Chunk: 3].
- Alex runs the deployment on the GPU server and sets up its monitoring and alerts [Doc: Project Alpha launch plan (sample), Chunk: 3] [Doc: Weekly sync, 9 September 2026 (sample), Chunk: 3].
- Lena leads marketing and starts the launch campaign on 14 September 2026 [Doc: Project Alpha launch plan (sample), Chunk: 3] [Doc: Weekly sync, 9 September 2026 (sample), Chunk: 2].

- The steering group meets every Tuesday at 10:00 [Doc: nebula-kickoff.pdf, Chunk: 1].

The kickoff on 14 September 2026 did not settle how drivers give feedback during the beta, which was recorded as an open question, and the next review was set for 12 October 2026 [Doc: nebula-kickoff.pdf, Chunk: 1].

**Darf das Außenlager Lechfeld aus der Ferne gewartet werden?**

Nein, für das Außenlager Lechfeld ist Fernwartung grundsätzlich untersagt [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 4]. Im Werk Süd und im Werk Nord ist die Weboberfläche von außerhalb des Werksnetzes nicht erreichbar, Fernwartung läuft dort nur über die Box LinkGuard R2 von Nordwall IT [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 4].

- Ohne schriftliche Freigabe startet keine Sitzung, und eine mündliche Freigabe reicht nicht aus [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 4].
- Stefan Kroll vom Support der Tessner Automation GmbH darf Sitzungen für GW-08 begleiten, Firewall-Regeln ändern darf er jedoch nicht [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 4].

**Welche Grenzen gelten für Stromversorgung und Temperatur beim Gateway?**

| Thema | Vorgabe |
|---|---|
| Versorgung | 12 V DC oder 24 V DC bei einem Eingangsbereich von 10 V bis 36 V DC; Power over Ethernet wird nicht unterstützt [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 2] |
| Betrieb | zulässig von -10 °C bis +55 °C, oberhalb von 55 °C ist der Betrieb nicht erlaubt [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 2] |
| Lagerung | -30 °C bis +70 °C [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 2] |

Eine Kühlung per Lüfter ist nicht vorgesehen, und im Außenlager Lechfeld darf das Gateway nur im beheizten Gehäuse TG-5 von Tessner Automation laufen, weil die Halle im Winter nicht beheizt wird [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 2].

**Unter welchen Bedingungen dürfen Werksdaten exportiert werden?**

1. Werksdaten dürfen die EU nicht verlassen; die Replikation der Datenhafen Cloud in andere Regionen ist abgeschaltet [Doc: Richtlinie Datenaufbewahrung und Zugriff Werk Süd (Beispiel), Chunk: 4].
2. Mirava Analytics bekommt ausschließlich verdichtete und pseudonymisierte Daten, Rohdaten gehen nie dorthin [Doc: Richtlinie Datenaufbewahrung und Zugriff Werk Süd (Beispiel), Chunk: 4].
3. Kleinere Exporte ohne personenbezogene Daten sind für Instandhalter erlaubt, Exporte über 2 GB brauchen dagegen die Freigabe von Katrin Albers [Doc: Richtlinie Datenaufbewahrung und Zugriff Werk Süd (Beispiel), Chunk: 4].
4. Im Werk Süd sind USB-Datenträger verboten, im Außenlager Lechfeld ist ein USB-Export nur am verschlüsselten Laptop LT-11 möglich, und auch das nur, wenn Lukas Hoffmann den Port zuvor freigeschaltet hat [Doc: Richtlinie Datenaufbewahrung und Zugriff Werk Süd (Beispiel), Chunk: 4].

**Was ist bei Firmware und Logs ausdrücklich ausgeschlossen?**

Die von Tessner Automation zurückgezogene Firmware 3.9.2 darf nie installiert werden; den Rückzug hat Stefan Kroll am 28. März 2027 bestätigt [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 5]. Automatische Updates sind auf keinem Gateway aktiv, stattdessen spielt Florian Brandt Updates samstags zwischen 22:00 und 01:00 Uhr ein [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 5].

Im Produktivbetrieb bleibt das Debug-Logging ausgeschaltet [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 6]. Logs liegen 5 Tage auf dem Gateway und gehen danach an TresorStore [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 6].

**Kann ein Gateway ohne Weiteres an den Hersteller zurückgeschickt oder entsorgt werden?**

Nein: Kein Gateway wird außer Betrieb genommen, ohne dass ein Ticket von Lukas Hoffmann vorliegt [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 7]. Vor dem Versand löscht das Werkzeug CleanSlate von Tessner Automation Konfiguration und Zertifikate, und das Löschprotokoll wird in TresorStore abgelegt [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 7].

Ohne Löschprotokoll geht kein Gateway an den Hersteller zurück, und auch die Recyclon GmbH darf Altgeräte nicht ohne Löschprotokoll entsorgen [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 7]. Speichermodule aus dem Außenlager Lechfeld werden nie verschickt, sondern vor Ort vernichtet [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 7].

**Wann wird der nächtliche Löschlauf angehalten?**

| Punkt | Regel |
|---|---|
| Start | Der Löschlauf für abgelaufene Daten beginnt jede Nacht um 02:15 Uhr [Doc: Richtlinie Datenaufbewahrung und Zugriff Werk Süd (Beispiel), Chunk: 5] |
| Unterbrechung | Er wird nicht angehalten, es sei denn, ein Legal Hold ist aktiv oder Katrin Albers hat eine Unterbrechung schriftlich angeordnet [Doc: Richtlinie Datenaufbewahrung und Zugriff Werk Süd (Beispiel), Chunk: 5] |
| Legal Hold | Daten unter Legal Hold dürfen auch nach Ablauf ihrer Frist nicht gelöscht werden [Doc: Richtlinie Datenaufbewahrung und Zugriff Werk Süd (Beispiel), Chunk: 5] |

Es ist nicht so, dass jemand anderes als Dr. Ines Gramm aus der Rechtsabteilung einen Legal Hold setzen oder aufheben könnte [Doc: Richtlinie Datenaufbewahrung und Zugriff Werk Süd (Beispiel), Chunk: 5].

**Welche Ports nutzt das Gateway, und in welchem Zustand sind sie standardmäßig?**

- 9443 (HTTPS) ist für die lokale Weboberfläche da und standardmäßig aktiviert [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 3].
- 8883 überträgt per MQTT über TLS die Telemetrie an ProSight und ist ebenfalls aktiviert, während 1883 mit unverschlüsseltem MQTT für den Testbetrieb deaktiviert ist [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 3].
- 4840 bindet per OPC UA die Maschinen an ETH0 an und ist aktiviert, SSH auf Port 22 für die Herstellerdiagnose ist dagegen deaktiviert [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 3].
- Port 1883 ist nur im Testnetz von Werk Nord erlaubt und im Produktionsnetz verboten [Doc: Betriebsspezifikation Edge-Gateway EG-400 (Beispiel), Chunk: 3].
